items.text: Simple and intuitive with a beautiful design. The app is easy to navigate, everything works smoothly, and the user interface is clean and modern. Highly recommend! 🤩
Finally a habit tracking app that doesn't have basic features behind a paywall. Hopefully this app gains more users in the future.

simple, clean ui, and does exactly what i want it to do. my only complaint is that you can only set one time for a notification reminder per habit, which isn't helpful for tasks that you want to repeat multiple times in one day. otherwise its great
best app for tracking so far
